limitations: The metric is the Poincaré/Bookstein metric, not Kendall's spherical/Procrustes shape metric. Only nondegenerate Euclidean triangles are included; degenerate shapes lie at the ideal boundary. The labeled identity uses a fixed side correspondence; the quotient formula handles relabeling and reflection. The inaccessible 1988 review remains a specific originality risk.
